test_chamfer_distance_naive: test the chamfer_distance_naive function by computing pairwise squared distances between two point cloud tensors
test_chamfer_distance_naive_pointclouds: test the chamfer_distance_naive_pointclouds function by computing chamfer distance on heterogeneous Pointclouds objects with normals
test_init_pointclouds: test the init_pointclouds method to create random Pointclouds objects with padded points and normals tensors
test_chamfer_joint_reduction: test chamfer_distance with all combinations of batch_reduction and point_reduction settings including mean and sum
test_chamfer_gradient_check: test gradient correctness by comparing backward pass gradients between naive and vectorized chamfer distance implementations
